name: GHOST MERIDIAN: Full Immersion Edition
description: The definitive BCI title of its generation, Ghost Meridian drops players directly into a neural-rendered replica of M88 itself — every alley, every Shelf hab-stack, every Spire penthouse reconstructed with sensory fidelity so precise that players report smelling synth-protein stalls and feeling cold Lake Michigan wind. You inhabit a customizable ghost operative navigating corporate conspiracy across all five tiers, with full tactile feedback including pain dampening set at 30% by default. Over 400 million registered neural-profiles have logged at least one session since launch, making it the most-played BCI title in megacity history.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 courier discovers that a Ghost Meridian NPC has been feeding them real corporate intelligence — someone is using the game's neural-render layer as a dead-drop.
A Shelf teenager's ghost operative account has accumulated more Quanta than her family earns in a year; someone wants to know how, and they're not asking nicely.
A grieving father realizes his deceased daughter left a full neural-recorded 'life' hidden inside her Ghost Meridian save file — a complete second existence he never knew about.
